better_than_linear.derivation: E: y^2=x^3+x over F_p^2 (i^2=-1), p=92935740571 (p%4=3; p+1=4*l, l=23233935143 prime; #E(F_p)=p+1, #E(F_p^2)=(p+1)^2). K=(6312697112+11428792286*i, 30552079595+78608501229*i) verified on-curve, l*K=O and 4K!=O => order(K)=l exactly, so deg(isogeny)=#<K>=l=23233935143. Birational map to Montgomery B*y^2=x^3+A*x^2+x with A=3/sqrt2 (u=sqrt(-1/2), x_M=u*x_SW-A/3). Subquadratic (Bernstein-De Feo-Leroux-Smith style, better-than-linear-in-inversions) evaluation of the cyclic-subgroup products over s=1..l-1 via batched Montgomery x-only ladder scan (16 parallel threads, batched inversions) giving Sigma=SUM(x_s - 1/x_s), P=PROD(x_s), H+=PROD(x_s-1), H-=PROD(x_s+1). Route 1 (harmonic/sum formula): A'CH = P*(A-3*Sigma). Route 2 (independent Edwards route): d = ((A-2)/(A+2))^l * (H+/H-)^4, A'ED=2(1+d)/(1-d). Full-scale run: A'CH == A'ED == (57125959000, 24629365419) (MATCH: True). j = 256*(A'^2-3)^3/(A'^2-4) = (91493879515, 48495725269), i.e. j = 91493879515 + 48495725269*i. Both route formulas validated against brute-force Velu ground truth on 5 small instances (p=19,83,103,67,151; l=5,7,13,17,19) with exact match on j, then rerun end-to-end to reproduce. Answer format 'a*i + b' => '48495725269*i + 91493879515'.

mega2.derivation: Server (13409.py, live at socket.cryptohack.org:13409) publishes Alice's RSA-2048 private-key blob AES-ECB-encrypted under a master key (4 length-prefixed fields p,q,d,u) and a login oracle login_step2 that RSA-CRT-decrypts any submitted SID_enc with the parsed key, returning long_to_bytes(m)[:-16] (top 1920 bits of m). Attack (MEGA-style fault + truncated Bellcore): (1) pick x=X0*2^128 (<n), send SID_enc=x^e mod n so the true plaintext is exactly x with the truncated part zero. (2) Resend share_key_enc with one 16-byte ECB block wholly inside u's data region (bytes 520..647) replaced by random bytes -> parsed u' is garbage while d,p,q stay intact: mp=pow(ct,d,p)=x mod p stays exact but the CRT combine gives m'=mp+p*h' with random h', hence m'-x = z*p exactly (Bellcore fault). (3) Response leaks H=m'>>128; set A=(H-x) mod n = z*p - L, L=m' mod 2^128 unknown. (4) Recover L via a vanishing-polynomial lattice: LLL on the Z-lattice of coefficients (scaled by X^k, X=2^128) of {N*x^j} U {(x+A)*x^i}; the short combination q*(x+A) - z*N has L as an exact integer root; gcd(A+L,n)=q, verified q*(n/q)=n. (5) get_encrypted_flag -> AES-ECB decrypt with key SHA256(long_to_bytes(p)||long_to_bytes(q)) -> PKCS7 unpad -> flag. Validated on an exact local replica of the server first (3/3 factor+flag round-trips), then run live: 1 sanity login + 1 faulted login (2 of 4 logins), flag received.
